factions.name: The Concord
factions.description: A federation of survivors, united by a fragile promise. Receives one additional order each turn.

factions.name: Veyr Consortium
factions.description: Trade leagues that turn the frontier into opportunity. Earns 25% more credits.

factions.name: Khar Dominion
factions.description: A martial society forged on hostile worlds. Warships deal 15% more damage.

factions.name: The Luminous Choir
factions.description: A communion seeking the intelligence behind the ancient gates. Produces 25% more science.

log.text: Khar Dominion achieves transcendence. The chronicle of this age is complete.
Khar Dominion reaches 10/10 Asterion alignment.
Khar Dominion reaches 8/10 Asterion alignment.
Khar Dominion has restored an Asterion Beacon at Meridian (4 owned).
Meridian changed sovereignty from The Luminous Choir to Khar Dominion.
The Luminous Choir’s Asterion alignment is interrupted (6/10).
Khar Dominion reaches 5/10 Asterion alignment.
The Luminous Choir reaches 5/10 Asterion alignment.
Khar Dominion declared war on The Luminous Choir.
Khar Dominion begins Asterion alignment (1/10). Three beacon worlds must remain operational; each advancing cycle costs 60 credits.
Khar Dominion broadcasts an Asterion Beacon at Corvus. Its location is now charted.
The Luminous Choir begins Asterion alignment (1/10). Three beacon worlds must remain operational; each advancing cycle costs 60 credits.
The Luminous Choir broadcasts an Asterion Beacon at Meridian. Its location is now charted.
Khar Dominion broadcasts an Asterion Beacon at Caldera. Its location is now charted.
Khar Dominion broadcasts an Asterion Beacon at Kharos. Its location is now charted.
The Luminous Choir broadcasts an Asterion Beacon at Ophion. Its location is now charted.
The Luminous Choir broadcasts an Asterion Beacon at Lumen. Its location is now charted.
Solace completed Research Enclave.
Veyr Consortium has collapsed.
Trade route established between Veyr Consortium and The Concord. Borders are open.
Trade route established between The Luminous Choir and The Concord. Borders are open.
First contact: Veyr Consortium. A diplomatic channel is open.
First contact: Khar Dominion. A diplomatic channel is open.
First contact: The Luminous Choir. A diplomatic channel is open.
First mandate: send your Pathfinder through a starlane, then bring a Colony Ark to a habitable world.
The gates have been silent for centuries. Today, the Concord returns to the stars.
